Class TaskDialog

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.Dialog
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.TaskDialog
public class TaskDialog extends Dialog
The form a task is added and edited in: its title and description, each with a count of its characters against the limit, and, for a task already saved, its status. A new task starts Pending. Saving goes through the service, which trims both texts and refuses a blank title or a text over its limit with a sentence the form shows.
Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan

    • leaveOnTab

      private void leaveOnTab(javafx.scene.input.KeyEvent event)
      Moves the focus on from the description with Tab, and back with Shift+Tab, rather than typing a tab into it: a task's description has no use for one. A text area moves the focus on Ctrl+Tab, so Tab is handed to it as that.
      Parameters:
      event - the key pressed in the description
